drivingQuestion: What is R' Yosei b. R' Yehuda's reason?
outcomeNote: reason supplied by comparison to the ox

segments.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: עַד שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָדָיו וּבְרַגְלָיו. מַאי טַעְמָא דְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה? כִּי שׁוֹר, מָה שׁוֹר עַד שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָדָיו וּבְרַגְלָיו – אַף פּוֹעֵל עַד שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָדָיו וּבְרַגְלָיו.
segments.en: The mishna teaches that «Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Yehuda, says:» A laborer may not eat «unless he performs» labor «with his hands and with his feet.» The Gemara asks: «What is the reasoning of Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Yehuda?» The Gemara explains: This halakha is «like» that of a threshing «ox; just as» one is not required to let «an ox» feed «unless it is performing» labor «with its hands and with its feet,» as it uses all four of its legs to thresh, «so too a laborer» is not entitled to eat «unless he is performing» labor «with his hands and with his feet.»
